name: code-formatter
tagline_zh: Python 代码乱成草稿？一键黑格整形，缩进、引号、换行全归位，连注释间距都给你收拾得服服帖帖，像换了个人写的。
tagline_en: Python code a mess? One click with Black—indents, quotes, line breaks all tidied, even comment spacing, like.
desc_en: Formats Python code using the black formatter
why_zh: 直接调用 Black 官方格式化器，不是简单替换，而是完整重排语法树，连嵌套结构都按规范重写。
why_en: It invokes Black's official formatter, not a regex hack—reparses the AST and rewrites nested structures, so the output is.
